title: Tick gloss: an optional short label shown next to every id
description:
Bare tick ids ('kdn', '2jn') are unreadable without a lookup, and titles here are sentences too long to repeat beside an id. Operators want every mention written as 'id (gloss)', e.g. 'kdn (add google oauth login)'. Agents can paraphrase a title, but each one does it differently, and machine surfaces (pane titles, alerts, status views) cannot paraphrase at all — they need a stored value.

Change:
- An optional 'gloss' field on a tick, a few words (cap around 40 chars; the cap is refused with a message, not silently truncated), set with 'tk create --gloss' and 'tk update --gloss'.
- tk --json carries it, and the tk-json contract manifest in the bundle adds it (consumers such as ticfac pin that bundle).
- Fallback when empty: the title, cut to the same cap, so existing ticks never show a blank.
- tk list / tk show / tk graph print it next to the id.
- Skill: 'Mention a tick as id (gloss), never a bare id — in chat, reports, notes and commit messages. Set --gloss when a title is longer than a few words.' Examples in SKILL.md follow the convention.
acceptance_criteria: [A1] tk create/update accept --gloss, refuse one over the cap naming the limit, and tk --json emits it; a test covers set, update, over-cap refusal and the empty-gloss fallback. [A2] The tk-json contract manifest lists gloss as optional and the bundle's version is bumped. [A3] tk list and tk show print id (gloss), falling back to the cut title. [A4] SKILL.md states the id (gloss) rule and its tick-creation examples pass --gloss.
closed_reason: gloss field: tk create/update --gloss (40-char cap, refused not truncated), Validate, list/show/graph, schema + codegen, tk-json manifest (bundle 6.3.0), skill rule id (gloss); tests in internal/tick and cmd/tk/cmd
